title: the beginning of the protocol and its friction: the aim, the declaration, the register, the price of uncertainty
intent: A method that cannot be applied to its own development cannot be checked on it, and an agent that may declare anything will declare what it hopes. So the protocol came with friction where agents make mistakes - the aim must come from a person, a claim needs a way to be closed and something that would refute it, and uncertainty must have a price - and with the first claims the method itself holds.
objection: объявление утверждения требует цели, а цель сформулировал человек: агент не может начать, если человек ещё не сформулировал цель
refuted_by: агент получает право объявлять без цели, и это оказывается полезнее
